Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 39

“Knowledge is covered by this constant enemy of the wise, Kaunteya — by this insatiable fire in the form of desire.”

Note the phrase constant enemy of the wise. Krishna is clear that knowing better does not retire the problem, and the fire is called insatiable rather than merely strong.
